page.overview:
Who is Ogel?

Ogel, often referred to with the title Evil Ogel and occasionally stylized as OGEL, is the villain of the Alpha Team theme.

The original 5714 LEGO Alpha Team video game design of Ogel has a plain black torso/arms and legs, a custom armor piece, and a black helmet with a large gold visor. His face is never revealed. The color of his hands is inconsistent, with his in-game appearances in LEGO Alpha Team having yellow hands, but the intro animation for LEGO Logic giving him black hands. The final intro for the LEGO Alpha Team game shows him with both yellow and black hands at different points. This design is also used in Evil Music with yellow hands.

When LEGO released sets based on LEGO Alpha Team in 2001, Ogel's design was tweaked. He is given a slightly modified version of Alien, Breast Plate, as the original version of the piece does not allow his Mini Crash Helmet to fit properly. His helmet's visor is represented with a metalized gold Space Visor. His hands are now consistently black, and his face is revealed (which partially recycles Señor Palomar's face design, but with a different mouth and slightly higher placed eyes, one of which is red). It is unknown if Ogel's face was designed by the game developers and just never shown by them, or if LEGO designed the face themselves when it came time to produce physical sets.

In the Alpha Team Stunt Show, Ogel wears a black outfit with red chest and shoulderpads reminiscent of his video game armor, a red belt, and red stripes on his right leg. At some point during the show, Ogel wears a blonde wig with feminine pigtails.
